item.title: Vibe Coding with SoundCloud: Announcing New Docs for your Agents
item.description: 🚀 Exciting news for music app enthusiasts! SoundCloud has launched updated developer resources for “vibe coding.” Now, anyone can create music experiences without needing extensive programming skills. They’ve removed barriers to access the SoundCloud API, allowing instant generation of Client IDs for those with an Artist-Pro subscription. Additionally, new AI Agent Documentation ensures your coding companions have accurate information for seamless development. What will you create? 🎶💻…
